text:
sana: Quick sync — planning to stage-enable the SO shim & opt-in function-calling headers tomorrow AM for a small cohort. Asking for quick thumbs and any guardrail misses.

jordan: 👍 what size cohort? any routing rules?

sana: Start 5% of prod traffic, only in us-west region. Route by client_id in header, default off for older SDKs.

emily: How are we detecting SDK versions? we have some customers on the 0.x client that don't send version header.

sana: Good call. If no version header, treat as legacy and keep features off. New SDK (v1.2.0) will add `X-Redwood-SDK: v1.2.0` header.

lee: For telemetry — please ensure these metrics are ready: `so.enabled.requests`, `so.failure.rate`, `so.kvcache.hit_rate`, and `so.latency.p50/p95`. Also add a tag for `sdk_version`.

mike: I can add the metrics. Also propose a rapid rollback circuit: if `so.failure.rate` > 0.5% for 5m OR p95 latency increases > 30% vs baseline, we flip the flag off automatically. Is that acceptable?

sana: Yes, that seems reasonable. Add a notification to #incidents and page on flip.

qa-bot: QA checklist reminder: run the following smoke tests against canary traffic: 1) basic function call roundtrip 2) missing/extra fields in outputs 3) unexpected JSON escaping 4) streaming fallbacks.

emily: For case 2, we should add contract fuzz tests from the eval harness. I'll queue a job.

jordan: Client-side behavior: SDK must expose opt-in boolean `enableStructuredOutput` and also inject the header. Backwards compat: default false. We should also ship a small warning log when SDK sees server schema mismatch.

sana: Docs: add a short migration note and a compatibility table (server flag vs SDK version) on the dev portal. I'll draft it.

lee: One more thing — confirm tokenization differences: some of the new models change token counts for function payloads. Add token delta tracking metric `so.tokens.delta` so costs don't surprise customers.

mike: infra-bot can we gate rollout with a dynamic traffic-split rule?

infra-bot: Deploy plan created: ORCHESTRATION-2335. Traffic split rule: header match `X-Redwood-Canary: so-shim-v1` -> 5%. Fallthrough -> 0%. Auto-scale policy attached.

sana: Perfect. Can we also create a short-lived feature-flag key named `so_shim_v1` on the feature-store with rollout window 48h and audit logging enabled?

infra-bot: Feature flag `so_shim_v1` created. Audit: enabled. Window: 48h.

emily: Who's owning post-deploy regression triage for the first 12h?

jordan: I'll take rotation first 4h, then emily next 4h, then sana fallback. Add on-call notes to the rollout doc.

sana: Tiny config snippet for anyone trying locally:

```
# curl example to opt in
curl -H "X-Redwood-SDK: v1.2.0" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Canary: so-shim-v1" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
     -d '{"input":"call fn with args"}' \
     https://api.redwood.company/v1/generate
```

mike: Also ensure client-facing error surfaces contain the `accepts_function_calls` boolean so SDKs can present a graceful fallback.

lee: I'll add alert thresholds and runbooks. One ask: add a step in the runbook to check schema compatibility via `eval-harness compare --latest-canary` so engineers can quickly confirm regressions.

sana: Thanks all. If no objections, we flip the switch at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Post any objections here by EOD. :thumbsup:

jordan: No objections from infra side.

emily: No objections from QA. I'll post results 2h after start.

mike: All set from infra.

sana: Great — proceeding. I'll update the rollout doc with these notes and a direct link to the feature-flag page.

infra-bot: Canary rollout started: 5% traffic -> `so_shim_v1` at 09:00 PT.

qa-bot: Smoke tests running against canary; ETA 18 minutes.

(End of thread)
